# Reservoir_State_Projection

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The mapping of input signals onto high-dimensional reservoir states, which are then linearly read out to reconstruct the original waveform. Bridges physical reservoir dynamics with signal processing, enabling efficient analog-to-information conversion in TCC/iNEST architectures.
